caveats: CORPUS TIER: every number in this folder is from the _only_subset tier (NV 15pp of 98, KY 8pp of 120), never full documents.

KY'S DETECTOR GOLDEN IS EXHAUSTIVE AND NV'S IS NOT, AND THE TWO MUST NOT BE PRESENTED THE SAME WAY. KY: 44 golden vs 44 in-scope detections with zero unmatched detections, so its raw precision 1.000 is a genuine hallucination-free result and guardrail 8's carve-out applies. NV: golden_is_exhaustive is false (46 vs 53), and raw precision 0.8679 EQUALS the annotation-coverage ceiling 0.8679 to four decimals, so the raw figure carries no information about correctness. NV's real number comes from the audit.

NV'S CEILING MOVING 0.7736 -> 0.8679 IS AN ANNOTATION-COVERAGE CHANGE, NOT A QUALITY IMPROVEMENT. It moved because the golden grew from 41 to 46 entries. Nothing about the detector got better. Label it that way or the paper misleads.

THE NV FP AUDIT IS SIGNED (Emily Cheyne, 2026-08-23, 0 verdicts changed), so NV verified precision 0.9811 IS quotable. BUT the paper sentence 'all unmatched in-scope detections of the recorded run were manually audited by the author' is true ONLY for the held-out states. Task 1b still owes 156 verdicts for AZ/CA/CO/TX, so that sentence must be scoped to NV/KY until Task 1b lands. The signature lives in nv_fp_audit_SIGNED.json because heldout_evidence.py hardcodes verified_by='claude-first-pass-UNSIGNED' and re-running it would clobber the signature in heldout_evidence.json.

NEITHER AUTOMATED TEXT PROBE IN fp_audit IS SUFFICIENT, IN EITHER DIRECTION (measured 2026-08-23). title_contiguous_in_extraction OVER-flags: multi-column tables flatten into interleaved reading order, so correct titles score 0 contiguous matches — it flags 39 plainly-real rows across CO/TX. title_spans_found_in_order UNDER-flags: greedy longest-first decomposition shatters a title into fragments that occur somewhere in any document, and NV's one CONFIRMED hallucination PASSES it ('peers with'/'adult'/'guidance' all found) despite the phrase 'with adult guidance' occurring 0 times. A verdict must rest on phrase-level checking of the DIFFERING portion plus structural comparison against the matched twin, never on either probe alone.
NV DESCRIPTION ACCURACY HAS A DENOMINATOR OF 3. Only 3 of NV's 46 golden elements annotate a description, so report 2/3 and never the rate 0.667. KY's denominator is 26 and is sound.

NV'S DESCRIPTION MISS IS A DIRECT-PATH ARTIFACT OF A BATCHED-PATH FIX. _splice_overlapping_prose cannot fire on the direct path the detector eval runs, so this suite will always show the Science description truncated at 2410/3500 while the batched pipeline reconstructs it to 3500 byte-exact. Do not judge that helper by this eval and do not delete it because this number does not move.

AGE-BAND DROPS CARRY NO INDEPENDENT SIGNAL WHEN RECALL IS 1.000: age_band_drops is a strict subset of missing_test_cases, so 'age-band drops: 0' follows arithmetically from recall 1.000 in both states and is not a separate confirmation.

CODE AND DESCRIPTION ACCURACY ARE CONDITIONED ON THE TITLE ALREADY MATCHING EXACTLY: both are graded over matched pairs only. Vacuous this run because recall is 1.000 in both states, but the metric names do not say so.

THE GRADED DEPTH MAP IS NOT THE ONE THAT DROVE THE GRADED DETECTION: evaluate_state calls infer_depth_map a SECOND time purely for grading. Both states PASS and the two calls agreed, but a PASS is not proof the detection ran on a correct map.

PARSER FIELD ACCURACY AVERAGES OVER CELLS WHOSE GOLDEN IS NULL. Both states also report field_accuracy_over_asserted_cells_only in summary.json; this run both are 1.0000, so the distinction happens not to bite — but it must still be stated.

NEITHER BATCHING LAYER IS EXERCISED AT THIS CORPUS TIER: NV produces 5 chunks and KY 3 against MAX_CHUNKS_PER_BATCH=5, and both have 3 domains against MAX_DOMAINS_PER_BATCH=3, so detection and parsing each run as exactly one batch. No batching or scale claim may rest on these states; that is Task 6.

THE PARSER EVAL RUNS THE DIRECT PATH FOR DETECTION WHILE READING BATCHED DETECTIONS, AND THE TWO PATHS DEMONSTRABLY DIVERGE. The detector half of this folder re-runs detection live; the parser half reads outputs/08-22-26-4. They are not grading the same detection of the same document.

A CLEAN RUN DOES NOT RETIRE THE INTERMITTENT MALFORMED-PRIMARY-KEY DEFECT. Zero standard_id collisions and all 7 parser regressions PASS this run, including the two that failed on 08-01/08-16 with bare codes (TCPHS, UMNDW). Per CLAUDE.md that defect is sampling variance across identical frozen inputs at temperature 0, so one clean run is not evidence of a fix. The durable mitigation is validator._validate_code_shape, which neither eval suite exercises.

NO TASK 3 ABLATION NUMBER EXISTS. The off-arm aborted on a Bedrock daily-token-quota ThrottlingException after completing only AZ. paper/results/task3_20260822/ contains a quarantined report in which five of six states read n_detected=0/recall=0.0 — those zeros are the throttle, not the ablation, and must never be quoted.
